methodology: Transform of docs/workout-modifiers/limitation-dataset-audit.json — no re-resolution, no clinical judgment. clinicalDecision is always null.

reviewStatusModel.PENDING: Row identified by the audit, not yet triaged.
reviewStatusModel.NEEDS_CLINICAL_REVIEW: Triaged — requires a content/clinical decision before any dataset edit.
reviewStatusModel.APPROVED: A specific resolution was clinically approved but not yet applied to the dataset.
reviewStatusModel.REJECTED: A proposed resolution was reviewed and rejected; needs a different proposal.
reviewStatusModel.RESOLVED: Applied to the dataset AND re-validated by the real resolver (see quality gate) as producing a valid combination.
